# Townhall

> > Leading conservative news and political commentary platform featuring analysis from columnists like Victor Davis Hanson, Kurt Schlichter, Derek Hunter, and Josh Hammer on current events, policy, and American politics.

Townhall provides daily conservative perspectives on breaking news, Trump administration policies, Middle East conflicts, Senate races, and constitutional issues. The site features political cartoons, congressional commentary, and in-depth analysis from prominent conservative voices and legal experts.

## Key Topics

- Conservative Commentary
- Trump Administration
- Victor Davis Hanson
- Kurt Schlichter
- Derek Hunter
- Josh Hammer
- Middle East Policy
- Iran Conflict
- Israel Relations
- Political Cartoons
- Congressional Analysis
- Constitutional Law
- Senate Races
- Breaking Political News
- Editorial Satire

## Core Pages

- [Townhall - Conservative News, Political Analysis and Commentary](https://townhall.com/): Homepage featuring conservative news, opinion, and analysis by Katie Pavlich
- [Political Cartoons Daily & Weekly – Townhall](https://townhall.com/political-cartoons): Daily political cartoons by Steve Kelley, Gary Varvel, and other artists

## Featured Columnists

- [Articles by Judge Andrew Napolitano](https://townhall.com/columnists/judgeandrewnapolitano): Constitutional law analysis and civil liberties commentary by Judge Napolitano
- [Articles by Congressman Paul Gosar](https://townhall.com/columnists/CongressmanPaulGosar): Political commentary by Arizona Rep. Paul Gosar on policy and government
- [Articles by Congressman Markwayne Mullin](https://townhall.com/columnists/CongressmanMarkwayneMullin): Political commentary by Oklahoma Rep. Markwayne Mullin on policy issues

## Financial & Economic Analysis

- [Articles by Wall Street Daily](https://townhall.com/columnists/WallStreetDaily): Financial analysis and investment commentary from Wall Street Daily
